age.text: C needs one new column: when the last play last changed. The board only knows when it last polled, not when the play happened.

round2.text: Round 2: the mix and a richer sheet

tier.text:
We're on CFBD Tier 3 ($10/mo, 75,000 calls, confirmed 2026-09-23): live play-by-play and drives are available, so the play type, the play's start spot and the drive come from the feed, not from guesses.

The field ships behind a flag until Jonah is confident in it. PostHog flags are off (they leaked join tokens), so the flag needs another mechanism.

title.text: Live Board: down-and-distance, last play, who has the ball

anim.text:
Press Play on this board to watch an Alabama drive: kickoff, run, pass, a run for a loss, pass, sack, punt. Each play animates first; the drive band, down, spot and clock update only once the ball lands.

Arcs now stay inside the field. A play that loses yards draws in red, so it reads apart from the drive band below it.
